findings.evidence: Artin.lean:314 `exact ind_ofCharacter_mem_indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic C hC ρ hρ` and :283 `exact indClassFun_mem_indVirtualCharacters (P := fun C => IsCyclic C) hC hmem` — `hC : IsCyclic ↥C` is consumed only as family membership. Artin.lean:300 derives `Invertible (Nat.card C : k)` from `isUnit_natCard_subgroup C (isUnit_of_invertible _)`; `isUnit_natCard_subgroup {k G} [Semiring k] [Group G] (S : Subgroup G) (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : k))` (TauCeti/GroupTheory/Index.lean:169) holds for every subgroup. `virtualCharacters_eq_closure_irreducibleCharacters` (TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/CharacterTable/VirtualCharacter.lean:248) has no family hypothesis. `def indCharacterSet (𝒮 : Set (Subgroup G))` (Spanning.lean:233) is already general; grep shows `indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` occurs in no file outside Artin.lean.
findings.fix: Replace the cyclic-only definition by `indVirtualCharacterSpan k G (𝒮 : Set (Subgroup G)) := AddSubgroup.closure {f | ∃ χ ∈ indCharacterSet k G 𝒮, (χ : G → k) = f}`, restate the six supporting lemmas and both inclusions for arbitrary `𝒮` (the proofs go through verbatim, `hC` becoming the family-membership hypothesis), and specialize at the use sites.
findings.issue: `indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` and its API are fixed to `{C | IsCyclic C}` at the wrong level: the generating set is built from the already family-general `indCharacterSet k G 𝒮` (Spanning.lean:233), and cyclicity is never used in either inclusion. Same specialization in `indVirtualCharacterSetCyclic` (:122), `mem_indVirtualCharacterSetCyclic` (:128), `ind_ofCharacter_mem_indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` (:146), `indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic_le_iff` (:156), `indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic_le_virtualCharacters` (:171), `indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic_le_indVirtualCharacters_isCyclic` (:269), `indVirtualCharacters_isCyclic_le_indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` (:296) and `indVirtualCharacters_isCyclic_eq_indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` (:321). Consequence: the identification `indVirtualCharacters k G P = closure of P-induced irreducible characters` is unavailable for the elementary family, which this file already treats as a client (:329, :342, :349) and which Brauer's roadmap item needs.

summary: The prior `[Finite G]` over-assumption on the bundled per-subgroup induction map is fixed, and the new direct-sum/base-change API is correctly family-general. Remaining issue: the retained `indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` apparatus and its identification theorem are specialized to the cyclic family although cyclicity is inert in every proof, while every neighbouring construction takes a family parameter.
